input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: Section 9 is TrueLink's only warranty and it covers Year 2000 date handling only. There is no professional/workmanlike warranty for the Hosting or Support Services, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface, software or deliverables, no malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranty, and no repair/replacement/refund remedy; Section 3 gives only "reasonable commercial efforts" undertakings. That fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies), so we insert the preferred performance warranty at the end of Section 9. The disclaimer at p0076 is already carved back by "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so no change is needed there.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (i) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and, for a period of 90 days following performance, will conform to their documentation; (ii) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface, all related software and all deliverables will conform to their documentation; (iii) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code; and (iv) TrueLink will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is re-performance, repair, replacement, or refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services, Interface, software or deliverables.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only Year 2000 date handling, so we have added our standard performance warranty: professional and workmanlike Hosting and Support Services conforming to documentation for 90 days, 12-month conformance to documentation for the Interface, software and deliverables, no malicious code and compliance with laws, with repair, replacement or refund. We can discuss a 90-day software / 30-day services package if that is easier for you.
proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink performance and conformance warranty with repair/replacement/refund remedy to Section 9
